**Body**:

PCF triage of the Rounds 5-7 residuals. Three BUGs (#83 refusal-operand
sanitization, #84 roster-read swallow, #82 ADO cross-collection), one item filed
as BUG that I classify INCREMENTAL but cannot defer compliantly (#85), and one
INVEST-NOW that outranks all of them.

THE FINDING THAT REORDERS THE QUEUE: `.claude/hooks/lib/**` is a synced glob, so
all seven commits of security work on this branch are Class-A non-durable — the
next /sync-to-use rebuilds those files from loom and erases them. The proposal
cluster is already fenced STALE and names re-derivation as the next task; that
debt has since grown by seven more commits, two of them security fixes no entry
reflects. Landing the PR does not make the work durable. The proposal does.

Sweep-N returns EMPTY, and not because the backlog is clear: the
`deferred-quality` label and issue template do not exist in this repo, so no
INCREMENTAL item can currently be deferred compliantly per
product-completion-first MUST-2. That is why #85 sits in the BUG queue under a
classification I do not believe — recorded as a decision point rather than
resolved by mislabelling it.

Three decision points surfaced for ratification rather than self-decided (MUST-4):
#85's classification, #74's disposition now that PR #80 corrected its
classification, and whether the proposal re-derivation runs before or after merge
(recommended: after, because the STALE fence is what makes waiting safe).
